description: This file declares the interface for the Harvester RBus API, including functions for getting and setting configuration parameters, initializing and uninitializing RBus components, and retrieving various Wi-Fi and device diagnostic data via RBus. It defines constants, function prototypes, and includes relevant external dependencies.

methods.name: get_HarvesterMLORfcEnable
methods.description: Retrieves the current status of MLO RFC enable flag.

methods.name: set_HarvesterMLORfcEnable
methods.description: Sets the MLO RFC enable status and persists it in PSM.

methods.name: regHarvesterDataModel
methods.description: Initializes and registers MLO RFC RBUS data elements.

methods.name: rbus_StoreValueIntoPsmDB
methods.description: Stores a TR181 parameter value into the PSM database.

methods.name: rbus_GetValueFromPsmDB
methods.description: Fetches a TR181 parameter value from the PSM database.

methods.name: harvesterRbusInit
methods.description: Initializes the RBus with the specified component name.

methods.name: rbus_getBoolValue
methods.description: Retrieves a boolean value from a specified TR181 path.

methods.name: rbus_getStringValue
methods.description: Retrieves a string value from a specified TR181 path.

methods.name: rbus_getUInt32Value
methods.description: Retrieves a uint32 value from a specified TR181 path.

methods.name: rbus_getApAssociatedDeviceDiagnosticResult
methods.description: Fetches diagnostic results for associated devices using RBus.
